title: Facelift UI demo
description: A demo of one client facelift surface (cockpit, spend gate, Vault, privacy) from its design shots: the surface whole, then the one thing the eye should land on, zoomed until it reads.

body.subject: The {{surface}} surface of the Lampway client facelift, from the supplied design shot (input design_plate); the point it makes: {{point}}.
body.action: The shot appears whole for {{whole_s}} s, then the frame zooms to {{region}} until its text is at least {{min_text_px}} px, a pointer path (a drawn dot, no OS cursor) moves to the control, the control's state change is shown as a crossfade between the two supplied states when two are given, then the frame pulls back.
body.camera: 2D zoom and pan on the shot, eased; one zoom in and one pull back.
body.style: Night surface; the tag 'Design, in progress' on every design shot, in mono on the flame accent; {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image and reports each one, window.__frame(t) that sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone, and window.__audit() that lists the visible text with its box, size and colour. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. A design shot is never presented as the running app. Text baked into the shot is not measured by the self-check: zoom until it is at least min_text_px by its own size in the shot.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

point.description: the one thing this demo shows

region.description: the region to zoom to, as x,y,w,h in the shot's pixels

whole_s.description: how long the whole shot holds first

negatives: no design shot shown without its tag
no zoom that leaves the point unreadable

design_plate.description: the facelift design shot; a second one is the after-state of the control

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
